description: Phase 1: Implement shared parseHttpError helper in src/services/httpError.ts, refine formatActionableError in src/swarm/types.ts, and add masked app token input with save/clear in SettingsModal keys tab.
verification: parseHttpError parses JSON/HTML/status safely without HTML leaks; formatActionableError distinguishes provider errors from app-auth 401; SettingsModal manages app token in localStorage.

description: Phase 2 (Issues 1+4): Implement runSwarm in-flight guard, AbortController connect/idle timeouts, parseHttpError integration, SSE heartbeat in streaming.ts, Run Swarm disabled button, and double-click/hang tests.
verification: Rapid double-clicks dispatch only 1 POST; hung 401 or network disconnect times out safely without permanent loading spinner; SSE keepalive sends heartbeat comments; all useSwarmExecution tests pass.

description: Phase 3 (Issue 2): Refactor CortexDiagnosticsViewer to use parseHttpError, display calm app-auth state instead of red card on 401, pause polling after 401 until token changes, and guard envStatus in useSwarmSettings.
verification: Unauthenticated dashboard load shows calm token prompt without 30s 401 polling storms; valid token resumes polling; env status handles 401/failures gracefully.

description: Phase 4 (Issue 5): Add body timeout & parseHttpError to fetchAvailableModels in providerService.ts, optimize AgentConfigurator useEffect deps and deduplication, and add app-auth fallback text input.
verification: 401 during model fetch resolves promptly without hanging spinners; AgentConfigurator does not re-fetch infinitely; manual model text input available when token is missing.

description: Phase 5 (Issue 3): Remove silent 500k cut in useSwarmExecution.ts, add client char caps (500k data, 20k task) with live counters in App.tsx, and enforce 2MB bodyLimit on /api/swarm/stream & /api/swarm/analyze returning 413 JSON.
verification: Over-limit text in UI blocks Run Swarm with explicit counter message; backend rejects payloads >2MB with 413 JSON; bodies <=1.5MB accepted.

description: Phase 6 (Issue 6): Add public/robots.txt, configure production server.ts static handlers with correct MIME types, and restrict SPA shell fallback to GET/HEAD / and /index.html returning 404 HTML for unmatched routes.
verification: GET /robots.txt returns text/plain 200; GET /nope returns 404 HTML; POST / returns 404/405; /api/* returns 404 JSON; /api/health returns 200.

description: Phase 7 (Extras): Remove duelodds.pages.dev from CSP connect-src in server.ts and app.ts, and add loud production startup warnings in cortex.ts and learningState.ts when running on in-memory vector store.
verification: CSP connect-src cleaned up without altering CORS allowlist; NODE_ENV=production triggers clear warning logs when Qdrant is unavailable.

description: Phase 8 (Swarm CORS Before Auth): Extract createCorsMiddleware, mount before createAppAuthMiddleware in server.ts, skip duplicate CORS/auth in app.ts, deduplicate /api/swarm/feedback, and add cors.test.ts.
verification: POST /api/swarm/feedback from allowed origin without token returns 401 with Access-Control-Allow-Origin header; disallowed origin gets no ACAO; duplicate feedback returns 200 {duplicate:true}.

description: Phase 9: Run complete test suite and execute end-to-end verification checklist against punchlist requirements.
verification: All test suites pass (npm test, vitest, portable, simulation, server, cli, cors); all verification criteria from punchlist verified.
